summary: The registrant, Hines Global Income Trust, Inc., filed an 8-K to disclose its monthly net asset value (NAV) per share as of June 30, 2026, along with a description of its valuation process. The filing conveys no corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or capital return. Instead, it is a routine periodic disclosure of NAV updated monthly, accompanied by a valuation policy exhibit. The board's valuation committee and independent appraiser Altus Group reviewed the calculation. There is no transaction, special situation, or strategic change to analyze; this is a standard current report for an internally-managed REIT.
